purpose: Define immutable, explicitly typed agent-to-MASTER responses persisted in Git with deterministic paths, independent resolution records and no HUMAN domain conversation.

JOB_RESULT.purpose: Submit completed work, artifacts, Git trace, checks and open items.

JOB_ERROR.purpose: Report a technical execution failure with reproducible findings and safe-state evidence.

CLARIFICATION_REQUEST.purpose: Report ambiguous, incomplete or contradictory job instructions to MASTER.

CAPABILITY_MISMATCH.purpose: Report role, skill, domain, technology or identity incompatibility before unsafe work.

IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.purpose: Record a non-blocking improvement idea without changing the job or granting authority.

commonInvariants: Every response binds projectId, jobId, packageId, workItemId, agentId and identityRevision.
Every response pins the observed immutable job contract blob and exact response template.
A response never grants provider rights, expands scope, changes role or changes the job.
Blocking responses stop the affected execution before further product mutation.
The agent does not ask the HUMAN domain questions; MASTER owns clarification and escalation.
The HUMAN-visible agent chat emits only the minimal chatStatus and Git reference.
MASTER resolution is stored separately and may create a superseding job; the original response remains immutable.
An improvement proposal is advisory and cannot authorize continuation or mutation.
